area: Existing admin surfaces (golf/admin, baseball/admin, api/admin, golf/actions/admin, components/admin, lib/admin) — discovery for unified /admin command center
summary: There is exactly ONE real admin product today: /golf/admin — a 989-line fully client-rendered dashboard with 5 tabs (Overview, People, System, Intelligence/BI, Tracer), backed by a 3,792-line getAdminDashboardData() server action that assembles ~10 SECURITY DEFINER rollup RPCs plus service-role queries. Baseball has NO admin dashboard — only a single /baseball/admin/demo-sessions page with no layout guard (action-level role check only); baseball metrics ARE computed on every golf-admin load (rollup-b C5 RPC) but the only component that renders them (BaseballOps.tsx) is dead code with zero importers. The in-app event log Nick wants ALREADY EXISTS and is mature: admin_events table + server logger (lib/admin-logger.ts), client logger via POST /api/admin/log-event (auth-required, type-allowlisted, severity-clamped, rate-limited), error_logs via lib/server-error-logger.ts (used by ~234 files, dual-writes Sentry + DB), incident grouping/resolution libs, and Supabase Realtime subscriptions on admin_events/admin_client_errors/admin_api_perf_log. There is NO live Sentry API pull anywhere — SystemTab hardcodes 'Sentry: operational'. Access control is users.role === 'admin' (DB column, not an email allowlist), enforced in the layout server component and re-checked per action/route, but NOT in middleware (src/proxy.ts has zero admin-path logic) — so the current gate is 2-layer-ish, not the 3-layer middleware+server+RLS model Nick locked. Roughly 17 components + 3 whole action files (admin-people-data.ts, admin-system-data.ts, admin-bi-data.ts, ~870 lines calling 7 otherwise-unused RPCs) are orphaned dead code. CRM is cleanly identifiable (/golf/admin/crm subtree ~20k lines, /api/admin/crm/send-email, crm_* tables) but has two coupling points INTO the non-CRM admin: page.tsx queries crm_coaches for sidebar stats, and PeopleTab imports the CRM's BulkEmailModal for re-engagement email.
gaps: No middleware-layer admin gate: src/proxy.ts and lib/supabase/middleware.ts contain zero /golf/admin//baseball/admin path logic — locked decision 2's first layer does not exist yet
Access is role-column based (users.role='admin'), not a Nick-only email/user-id allowlist — any row with role='admin' gets in; needs migration to single super-admin allowlist

area: Admin access gating / auth-session model + CRM delineation (helmv3)
summary: Admin access today is gated by a single role check — `users.role === 'admin'` (enum public.user_role: coach/player/admin) — enforced at the golf admin layout, in per-action `requireAdmin()` copies, and in Postgres via a SECURITY DEFINER `public.is_admin()` function plus per-table "Admins can ..." RLS policies. There is NO email/user-id allowlist anywhere, and the root middleware does NOT gate /golf/admin or /baseball/admin at all (it only auth-gates /{sport}/dashboard and does baseball capability routing). Supabase auth is read server-side via @supabase/ssr cookie clients (src/lib/supabase/server.ts and middleware.ts) with a separate service-role client (src/lib/supabase/admin.ts). An in-app event log already exists: table admin_events (service_role INSERT, admin SELECT/UPDATE RLS) fed by src/lib/admin-logger.ts (server) and /api/admin/log-event (client, rate-limited, severity-clamped), plus error_logs. Sentry is SDK-only (instrumentation.ts / instrumentation-client.ts); no server-side Sentry REST API pull exists yet — that is net-new. The CRM is fully delineated: routes /golf/admin/crm/**, /api/admin/crm/send-email, /api/crm/** (unsubscribe + google-calendar), /api/cron/process-sequences + refresh-engagement, /api/webhooks/resend + resend-inbound; 14 crm-*.ts server-action files + resend-activity.ts; src/lib/crm/** (Gmail DWD send, Resend, spam/unsub); ~25 crm_* tables/views/matviews. Key risk found: the handle_new_user trigger casts raw_user_meta_data->>'role' into users.role, so the public signup endpoint could potentially mint role='admin'.
gaps: No email/user-id allowlist exists anywhere — 'admin' is purely users.role='admin' assigned manually in the DB; the locked single-super-admin allowlist (Nick only) is entirely new and needs a decision on mechanism (env-var allowlist vs DB flag vs both).
Middleware layer of the 3-layer gate does not exist for any admin path; /api/admin/* and /golf/admin are protected only at layout/action/RLS depth.

requireAdmin() is copy-pasted per action file (crm-engagement.ts, crm-templates.ts, send-email route, demo-tracking.ts, admin-data.ts) — no shared src/lib helper to build on; the command center should introduce one.
No server-side Sentry API integration exists (no SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN usage) — the helm-xs live-pull is greenfield.

admin_events has no categories for RLS denials, data-integrity check results, or cron/job outcomes being emitted in practice (the 'security' type exists but emission coverage is unverified); decision #3b partially overlaps this table — extend, don't duplicate.
Baseball has no /baseball/admin index or layout guard — only demo-sessions gated inside its server action.

Did not verify live prod state (which user rows actually hold role='admin', whether newer un-migrated policies exist) — repo-only read; memory notes schema_migrations is unreliable, verify via information_schema before the build.
/api/cron/process-sequences exists but is absent from vercel.json crons — CRM sequence scheduling state should be confirmed (but not touched).
risks: Privilege-escalation vector: handle_new_user() (SECURITY DEFINER trigger in the prod baseline) sets users.role from raw_user_meta_data->>'role' with fallback 'player', and 'admin' is a valid user_role enum value — a direct call to the public Supabase signup endpoint with user_metadata {role:'admin'} may self-mint an admin. The app's own signup action only offers 'player'|'coach', but the trigger does not restrict the cast. Must be closed before the command center makes role='admin' even more powerful.

Layout-only gating is bypassable in edge cases: Next.js layouts are not re-executed on all client-side navigations, and route handlers/actions are the real boundary — the new center must gate every server action/route handler individually plus middleware plus RLS, per locked decision.

Nearly all admin reads switch to the service_role client after the role check (createAdminClient bypasses RLS) — any missed requireAdmin() call in a new action is a full data leak on a SHARED prod DB serving live golf+baseball users; also memory: matview/table recreation auto-grants ALL to anon+authenticated (REVOKE after, verify pg_class.relacl), and agents have repeatedly shipped GRANT ALL TO anon on standing RPCs.

SECURITY DEFINER admin RPCs check auth.uid(), which is NULL under service_role JWTs — calling them with createAdminClient() raises 'Forbidden' 42501 (509-error incident documented in admin-data.ts); new rollup RPCs must be called with the admin's user-scoped client.

CRM RLS policies grant full CRUD to ANY users.role='admin' row — the same role that gates the command center also unlocks the CRM tables; the 'do not touch CRM' boundary is a code-level discipline, not a DB-level separation, unless the new design adds a distinct mechanism.
In-memory rate limiting in /api/admin/log-event resets per serverless instance — fine as-is, but do not rely on it as a security control when extending the event log.

area: Error-tracking wiring completeness (Sentry + in-app logging), Vercel config, cron jobs, API route patterns — helmv3 repo
summary: Sentry is fully installed and initialized on all three runtimes (client, Node server, edge) via @sentry/nextjs ^10.56.0, with source maps, releases, session replay, tracing, profiling, Vercel AI instrumentation, cron monitors, PII scrubbing, and a mature dual-write pipeline (Sentry + Supabase error_logs/admin_events tables via src/lib/server-error-logger.ts, used by 237 files). The requested "lightweight in-app event-log table" from locked decision #3 ALREADY EXISTS (error_logs + admin_events in the prod baseline migration). The wiring is ~90% complete; the real gaps are: (1) a dead legacy module src/lib/error-monitoring.ts that silently DROPS 10 server-side error calls in src/app/golf/actions/golf.ts in production, (2) middleware session-update failures swallowed with console.warn only (never become Sentry issues, never written to admin_events — this is exactly the auth-failure blind spot decision #3 calls out), (3) blanket 'AuthApiError' in server ignoreErrors suppressing ALL Supabase auth errors from Sentry, (4) no systematic capture of RLS denials / non-throwing Supabase {error} results — coverage is caller-opt-in, (5) /api/log-error requires an authenticated user so logged-out-user errors (login/signup flows) reach Sentry but never error_logs, (6) SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN present only in .env.example (must verify it exists in Vercel env or prod source-map upload silently degrades under silent:true), and (7) minor cron/vercel.json drift. 14 crons are scheduled in vercel.json; 5 more route handlers exist unscheduled (CRM sequence/engagement ones intentionally so). All 19 cron routes already use the server logger.
gaps: P0 — src/lib/error-monitoring.ts is a production black hole for server callers: src/app/golf/actions/golf.ts routes 10 logCritical/logError calls through it and they are dropped (sendToMonitoringService is window-gated, console path is dev-only). Migrate to server-error-logger and delete the module.

P1 — middleware.ts swallows updateSession failures with console.warn only: never a Sentry Issue (captureConsoleIntegration captures only 'error' level), never a row in error_logs/admin_events. Auth/session-refresh failures at the edge are invisible to the future command center.
P1 — sharedIgnoreErrors in src/instrumentation.ts contains bare 'AuthApiError', suppressing ALL Supabase auth API errors from server/edge Sentry, not just refresh-token expiry noise.

P1 — No systematic capture of RLS denials / non-throwing Supabase { error } results: coverage is opt-in per call site; need a shared wrapper (generalize with-baseball-action / with-lifting-action pattern or wrap the Supabase server client) that auto-logs PostgREST error codes like 42501 to logServerEvent.
P2 — /api/log-error 401s unauthenticated users, so client errors in login/signup/password flows reach Sentry but never error_logs — the in-app feed under-reports auth-flow failures.

P2 — SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN exists only in .env.example; must verify it is set in Vercel project env (team-scoped vars are invisible to `vercel env ls`) or prod source maps/releases/Suspect Commits are silently degraded (plugin silent:true).

P2 — Decision #3 extensions not yet present: no dedicated event types in admin_events for sign-in/sign-out/auth events, data-integrity check results, or deploy markers; logServerEvent supports it but nothing emits those categories today.
P3 — refresh-engagement cron header comment claims a vercel.json schedule that does not exist (doc drift; CRM-owned, so flag-only, do not touch).
P3 — error-monitoring.ts client paths (setUser/clearUser) duplicate use-auth.ts Sentry.setUser wiring — consolidation cleanup when the module is deleted.
Not verified (read-only, no network): whether the DSN in .env.production.local matches the live helm-xs/javascript-nextjs project, and whether Sentry is actually receiving events in prod right now.
risks: Shared production Supabase: any new event-log writes must reuse the existing error_logs/admin_events tables or add ONLY additive migrations; recreating tables/matviews auto-grants ALL to anon+authenticated (known project gotcha) — REVOKE and verify pg_class.relacl after any DDL.

server-error-logger.ts uses createAdminClient (service-role); calling it from edge middleware may not be edge-runtime-safe and would put a service-role path in middleware — needs an edge-safe variant or fire-and-forget fetch to an internal route instead.
Fixing golf.ts's dead logger will surface a backlog of previously-invisible production errors — expect a Sentry volume bump and triage noise the first week.
Narrowing the 'AuthApiError' ignore must keep the refresh-token expiry suppression, or Sentry gets flooded by normal session-expiry noise from idle tabs (the original reason it was added).
Opening /api/log-error to anonymous writers increases abuse surface on a production DB — keep the existing rate limit + 10KB context cap and add an anonymous flag rather than removing auth wholesale.
Do not route the new admin at /monitoring (Sentry tunnelRoute already rewrites it); /admin or /command-center are safe.

CRM exclusion zone confirmed within this scope: src/app/api/crm/*, src/app/api/cron/process-sequences, src/app/api/cron/refresh-engagement, crm_* tables (crm_email_suppressions, crm_coach_engagement seen), and /golf/admin/crm/* routes — the new command center must read none and write none of these.

area: Design system & visual direction for the unified cross-sport command center
summary: helmv3 has a mature, token-driven two-layer design system: a shared warm-cream "Fairway" foundation (OKLCH --fw-* tokens, warm-black rail, 20px card radius, Fragment Mono numerals, Recharts-based matte charts) plus a baseball-only "Living Annual" overlay (.living-annual scope that re-points the same --fw-* surface tokens to deeper cream, Space Grotesk via font-annual, clay/oxblood/sodium ink accents). Because Living Annual is literally a CSS-variable re-skin of Fairway, the command center should be built once from Fairway primitives (AppShell, MetricCard, StatTile, DataTable, ChartFrame) on the shared warm-black + cream language, using each sport's accent ink (green for golf, clay #C2703D for baseball) only as per-sport wayfinding — no third design language needed. Recommended route chrome: Fairway AppShell rail in warm-black (--fw-color-warm-950), canvas gradient page, MetricCard/StatTile KPI rows, DataTable for event/error feeds, ChartFrame+Recharts for trends, fw-danger/fw-warning/fw-success status tokens for severity.
gaps: Did not read ui-intelligence/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md or docs/baseball/design-system-living-annual.md in full (both exist and are the canonical specs the code comments cite — the executor should skim §4-§8 before building)

Did not inventory the golf/admin CRM sub-tree styling (src/app/golf/admin/crm/* — explicitly out of scope per locked decision 5, but its KPIGrid/Resend components live under the admin route that will be retired, so the retirement plan must carve the CRM out)

Did not verify how isRedesignEnabled()/FAIRWAY_SCOPE flag gating works in src/lib/redesign/flag — the command center should probably mount Fairway unconditionally (new route, no legacy to preserve) but the flag contract should be confirmed
Did not audit mobile behavior of DataTable/InstrumentPanel at admin data densities (kit was built for coach dashboards; ops tables may need a denser mode)
risks: Token collision foot-guns: 'success/warning/danger' exist twice (legacy flat hex vs fw-* namespaced) and 'glass'/'shadow-card' have both legacy and Fairway meanings — an executor mixing bg-success with fw-danger tokens will produce off-system colors; standardize on fw-* status tokens in the new console
The .living-annual scope silently re-points --fw-color-* surface vars for ALL descendants — wrapping a shared component in it changes its colors; only apply it to intentionally baseball-scoped panes

Admin motion gotcha is real and documented: without a LazyMotion domAnimation provider at the route root, m.* components render static and animated numbers freeze at 0 (this bit the Tracer KPI tiles before)

golf/admin retirement risk: the CRM (do-not-touch) lives INSIDE src/app/golf/admin/crm — retiring 'golf/admin' wholesale would delete the CRM; the plan must move/preserve that subtree and its role==='admin' + AdminNativeGuard gates
Recharts is ~100KB gz and evaluated client-side only in the current admin — the new console must keep dynamic ssr:false imports or it will regress initial paint
Repo is Tailwind v3.4 with a fragile tailwindcss-animate interop shim in tailwind.config.ts — do not attempt v4 @theme syntax or add plugins carelessly (a bad plugin resolution crashes ALL CSS)

area: Live data wiring feasibility for unified admin command center (env/secrets audit, read-only)
summary: Supabase service-role querying is fully wired today (createAdminClient + SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY present in local and Vercel-pulled prod env) and there is already an in-app event-log substrate (admin_events, error_logs, audit_log, login_attempts tables + admin-logger/server-error-logger writers), so the Supabase half of the command center needs zero new secrets. Sentry is wired for INGEST (DSN, org/project, withSentryConfig) but there is NO server-side Sentry REST API client anywhere in the repo and SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN is not visible in any pulled runtime env — a runtime-scoped SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN is the one near-certain new secret Nick must add. Vercel API access is half-built: admin-data.ts already calls api.vercel.com with VERCEL_API_TOKEN/VERCEL_PROJECT_ID/VERCEL_TEAM_ID and degrades to null when absent; those three names exist only in .env.example, not in any pulled env, so they likely need to be added too (project.json in .vercel/ supplies the IDs). auth.audit_log_entries is used nowhere and is not PostgREST-exposed; the established pattern to reach it is a SECURITY DEFINER RPC in public (same pattern as get_admin_errors_rollup) — a migration, not a secret.
gaps: Cannot see Vercel dashboard env vars from the repo: team/integration-scoped vars (possibly a Sentry-integration SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, possibly VERCEL_API_TOKEN) are invisible to `vercel env pull`, so 'not in .env.production.local' is strong but not conclusive evidence of absence — Nick should confirm in Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables before creating duplicates.
Did not verify the scopes of the existing local SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN in .env (values never read); if the Management-API path were chosen its scope/expiry would need checking.

Whether fetchVercelAnalytics currently returns real data in production (i.e., whether the token is secretly set) can only be confirmed by loading the live /golf/admin page or the Vercel dashboard, both outside this read-only repo pass.

No zod/t3-env schema exists to enumerate required env; the inventory was assembled by grepping process.env usage, so a var read only in an untouched vendor path could be missed (unlikely — SENTRY/VERCEL greps were exhaustive over src/ and scripts/).
risks: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN added for runtime API reads must be server-only (never NEXT_PUBLIC_) and minimally scoped (org:read/project:read/event:read); it grants org-wide read on helm-xs.

Direct-Postgres option for auth.audit_log_entries would put a superuser-grade DB URL into Vercel runtime env — recommend the SECURITY DEFINER RPC instead, and remember the standing gotcha that agents keep shipping GRANT/EXECUTE to anon on new RPCs (REVOKE from anon+authenticated, grant to service_role/admin only) and that recreating objects in public auto-grants ALL to anon+authenticated.
admin_events/error_logs writers use service role and bypass RLS — new command-center read paths must add their own admin gate at all three layers since table RLS won't protect service-role reads.
VERCEL_API_TOKEN is account-scoped by default (can read every project on the team); create it scoped/limited if possible and treat it like a production secret.

CRM exclusion: crm-engagement.ts sits in the same golf actions directory and gmail-send.ts/RESEND vars share the env files — the command center plan must explicitly avoid importing crm_* tables, CRM env vars, and src/lib/crm/*.
relevantTables: auth.audit_log_entries (not yet exposed — needs SECURITY DEFINER RPC)
